reviews.title: Feedback on the reading
reviews.text: I do not how this works but I will say this every single reading was on point. Talk about the universe aligning yes it does.
reviews.reply: Hi [Name]! Thank you for sharing your reflections — we truly appreciate hearing from you. 💜 It’s wonderful to know that the readings felt aligned and meaningful, offering you moments of clarity and connection. Our aim is always to create experiences that encourage self‑reflection and positivity, and your feedback reassures us that this approach is resonating. Your perspective is very valuable to us, as it motivates us to keep refining the service so it continues to feel authentic and uplifting for everyone. If you’d ever like our team to assist you more directly, please reach out at support-appstore@asknebula.com — we’ll be glad to help. Warm regards, The Nebula Team

reviews.title: All they want is money
reviews.text: Don’t even bother downloading, they gather all your data and then put the stuff you signed up for behind a fat paywall, this should be illegal, you should be told before hand if you’re going to get a whole lot of nothing if you don’t open your wallet. What a waste of time and your ui is trash, if I could give half a star I would
reviews.reply:
Hi there, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re sorry to hear that your experience left you feeling disappointed. Our goal is to provide a transparent experience and a variety of personalized spiritual tools, while allowing each person to choose which features they’d like to explore. We also appreciate your comments about the app’s interface, as feedback like this helps us improve.

If there’s anything specific you’d like us to review or clarify, please reach out to support-appstore@asknebula.com, and our team will be happy to assist.

With gratitude for your journey,
Nebula Team 🔮
